scope: Follow-up online service measurements and exploratory A100 reruns. Original pipeline exports are preserved separately.

validation.local_direct_checks: Frozen task roster, candidate indices, selected-output labels, CPU counter differences and role domains, within-allocation GPU identity, timeout metadata and call durations.
validation.local_scope_limit: The compact return omits full online-check and request-event originals. Complete replay of all six service wiring checks was not performed locally.

numeric_precision: Exact integer counter values and decimal/fraction timing values transcribed from the hash-bound compact originals. These refine, rather than replace, the unchanged rounded TSV exports.
